pride_data.title: Cross-linking mass spectrometry of purified human endosomes
pride_data.projectDescription: EndoMAP aims to systematically dissect the human endosomal protein complexes. Cross-linking experiments were performed on two biologically independent replicates of freshly prepared endosomal pellets from HEK293 cells to capture protein interactions and structures in purified organelles.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Organelles were immediately cross-linked by incubating with 1 mM DSSO (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at room temperature for 40min. The reaction was quenched with 50mM Tris buffer pH 7.5 at room temperature for 30 min. Cross-linked samples were denatured in 8M urea, reduced with 5mM dithiothreitol (DTT), and alkylated with 40mM iodoacetamide. Cross-linked proteins were digested with Lys-C at 37 °C followed by incubation with trypsin for 6h. Peptides were desalted with a 50mg C8 Sep-Pak column and fractionated by strong cation exchange (SCX) chromatography. A 70-min linear gradient of mobile phase (0.5M NaCl in 20% ACN, 0.05% formic acid) was used. Around 30 fractions per experiment were desalted and analyzed by LC-MS/MS using an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer with FAIMSpro. Peptides were fractionated with a 90-min linear gradient of acetonitrile using 100-μm C18 capillary column. An HCD-MS2 strategy was used, in which peptides with charge states 4-8 were fragmented by HCD at 21, 27 and 33% normalized collision energy and MS2 was acquired on the Orbitrap. FAIMS Pro was set to -50, -60 and -75 CV.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Data was searched using Thermo Proteome Discoverer (version 2.5.0.400) with the XlinkX module against the human canonical proteome (Uniprot Swiss-Prot 2022-05). MS2 acquisition strategy was selected with 10ppm precursor mass tolerance and 20ppm FTMS fragment mass tolerance. Carbamidomethylation was included as fixed modification; oxidation and N-terminal acetylation were included as variable modifications. A maximum of 3 trypsin miscleavages were allowed and 5 minimum peptide length. FDR threshold was set to 5% and only cross-links with XlinkX score >40 were considered for downstream analysis.
